QuestInfo.1: You've regrouped with the Green M-Forcer in Boswell Field near Omega Sector. Green said that the #rPlateons#k, which are much stronger than Mateons, are threatening to invade Omega Sector. He wants you to defeat the #rPlateons#k and bring back 50 #bPlateon's Helmets#k.
QuestInfo.2: I took out the Plateons and collected 80 Plateon Helmets, just the way Green M-Forcer from Boswell Field asked. The duties of the M-Forcers don't seem to be over, though, so if I have some time to spare, then I maybe I should go check Green M-Forcer then.

1.0: You've returned. Did the #r#o4230120##k give you any trouble? Doesn't look like it. And you got the #b#t4000121##k, too. HQ will definitely accept this as another completed mission. They sent this over for you!

yes.0: Did you get the #b50 #t2020009#s#k? This mission sure is more difficult that the last one, but I'm sure you had an easy time completing it. There are still some missions left from the Sector, so whenever you have time, please talk to me, alright?

item.0: It seems like you still haven't completed the mission from HQ. Take care of the #r#o4230120##k aliens that threaten Omega Sector and bring back 50 of their #b#t4000121##k items. They're stronger and more dangerous than the ones you fought before, so be careful!

0.0: I keep getting new tasks thrown at me from the Sector, and I'm busy beyond belief as a result. I've been actually waiting for your arrival. The news is, the aliens threatening the Sector now are much more powerful than the #o4230119# that you've previously faced.
0.1: The alien in question is #b#o4230120##k, and they are much higher ranked than #o4230119#, with the power to show for. What do you think? These may be much tougher than you've ever faced off against, but... will you do the honor of defeating each and every one of them?

yes.0: I knew you'd accept! Can you take care of the #r#o4230120##k aliens around the field and bring back their helmets? I don't want the aliens reusing any gear we can get away from them. I should be able to report back to HQ once you bring back 50 #b#t4000121##k items. Good luck!

no.0: I don't think this would necessarily do you any harm. If you have a change of heart, please talk to me. Until then, if you'll excuse me...
